title: Holiday problems
text:
Hi Kasia,

Greetings from Portugal! We arrived on Saturday, but our holiday didn't start very well. First, our flight was three hours late, so we got to the hotel after midnight. Then we found out that our room was not ready, and we had to sleep in a small room next to the kitchen. It was very noisy!

Luckily, things are much better now. On Sunday morning we moved to a big room with a balcony and a view of the sea. The hotel staff were very nice and gave us a free dinner because of the problems.

The beach is only five minutes from the hotel. The water is quite cold, but Tomek swims every day. I prefer lying in the sun and reading. Yesterday we rented bikes and rode along the coast to a small fishing village. We ate the best fish of our lives there!

We're coming back next Friday. I'll bring you some Portuguese biscuits.

Love,
Ewa
